text:
Sam: evening check — cut window ~2.5h. quick status: cherry queue has 3 PRs (one needs backport), canary still green but gpu-infra e2e flake is weird. trying a repro now.
Tess: thanks — which PRs? can you drop links? i want to see if any touch rollout code.
Sam: here: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2418 (backport needed), https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2430 (docs), https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2442 (hotfix). 2418 is the one that touched router; might affect rollout.
Praveen: FYI i noticed the canary latency spike earlier at ~15:12UTC, looks correlated with longer seq requests from bench harness. not sure if related to 2418.
Anika: re: gpu e2e — error log shows OOM during kv-cache warmup on GPU node g12, stack below:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory during kv_cache_alloc
  at serving/kernel_manager.py:142
  at runtime/kv_cache.py:88
```
Mika: are we able to repro locally with smaller batch? if it's kv-cache maybe sequence length or batch combo.
Sam: repro steps i'm running now: `./tools/e2e_run --suite=canary --seed=172 --profile=gpu` — failing consistently at step 4. will try lowering batch and seq.
DeployBot: Canary deploy queued for release-train-2026-04. ID: ct-5721. Status: waiting on health-checks.
Tess: can we gate the canary on the e2e job passing? right now dashboard shows canary flagged but still routing 5% traffic. can we drop to 0% until we triage?
Praveen: i can flip traffic policy — give me a thumbs-up from Sam once we've confirmed the repro.
Sam: +1, hold routing. I'm going to open a minimial repro PR if i find fix. expected timeline 40–60m.
Anika: if you need an interim mitigation, we can force a smaller default kv cache size via config: `export KV_CACHE_MAX_TOKENS=65536` and restart the runtime on canary nodes. low-risk.
Mika: i'll prep the restart playbook and keep an eye on logs. ping me if you want me to run it. :eyes:
Sam: will do. leaving this thread as single place for updates — i'll post when i have repro or rollback done. thanks all. :thumbsup:
